description: Finish src/link/Elf.sig: convert all remaining .sh_*/.st_*/.r_*/.d_* field accesses and SHT_*/SHF_*/STB_*/STT_* const refs to the typed model, redesign the section flag/type plumbing to typed (elf.SHT/elf.SHF/elf.PT/elf.PF), and verify the foreign-endian byteSwap path (RISKIEST SPOT #1) compiles over the typed enum/packed Shdr/Sym fields. Type tokens were already renamed; null_sym/null_shdr/shdrTo32/addSection shdr-build boundary already converted — do NOT redo those. This is the linker core that every other link/Elf/* file depends on, so it goes first.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/objdump-elf-disasm/A1-migration-spec.md (SPEC WINS) and plan.md step 1 + the name->member mapping table BEFORE editing.

In src/link/Elf.sig convert every remaining .sh_* field access per mapping (sh_type->type is now an elf.SHT enum; sh_flags->flags is a packed struct, read via .flags.shf.ALLOC/.WRITE/.EXECINSTR etc.; sh_name/sh_offset/sh_size/sh_link/sh_info/sh_addr/sh_addralign/sh_entsize -> name/offset/size/link/info/addr/addralign/entsize).

Convert .st_* accesses (st_info->info packed{type:STT,bind:STB}; st_type()->info.type; st_bind()->info.bind; st_other->other packed{visibility:STV}; st_name/st_value/st_size/st_shndx->name/value/size/shndx) and .r_* / .d_* accesses (r_offset->offset, r_addend->addend, r_sym()->info.sym, r_type()->info.type; d_tag->tag, d_val->val).

Replace SHT_* const refs: compare `shdr.type == .X`; where an int is needed use @intFromEnum(elf.SHT.X); build with `.type = .X`. The x86_64 unwind remap and the SHT_NULL/SHT_PROGBITS/SHT_PREINIT_ARRAY/SHT_INIT_ARRAY/SHT_FINI_ARRAY branches in initOutputSection (~1355-1420) switch on elf.SHT enum values.

Redesign flag/type plumbing to typed: AddSectionOpts.type: elf.SHT = .NULL and .flags: elf.SHF = .{} (~3437); addSection builds `.type = opts.type`, `.flags = .{ .shf = opts.flags }` (replace the current @enumFromInt/@bitCast boundary); initOutputSection(args) and getOrCreateMergeSection(~3623) take `flags: elf.SHF` and `@"type": elf.SHT`, with internal masking (flags & SHF_MERGE, flags &= ~(SHF_COMPRESSED|...), flags | SHF_WRITE) rewritten as bool-field logic on the packed SHF.

Rewrite shdrToPhdrFlags(~2619) to take `flags: elf.SHF` and return elf.PF, reading .shf.WRITE/.shf.EXECINSTR; update its 3 call sites (~2645/2739/2808) to pass shdr.flags.shf and consume typed PF. Make getPhdr(~3380)/addPhdr(~3394) opts `type: elf.PT`, `flags: elf.PF`; phdr-flag serialization writes @as(Word,@bitCast(pf)). Rewrite fmtShdrFlags(~3826)/formatShdrFlags to read SHF bool fields; fix the call at ~3822.
Fix the getOrCreateMergeSection(".comment", elf.SHF_MERGE|elf.SHF_STRINGS, elf.SHT_PROGBITS) call site (~1719) to pass typed values: `elf.SHF{ .MERGE = true, .STRINGS = true }`, `elf.SHT.PROGBITS`.
Ensure Ehdr size uses @sizeOf(elf.Elf64.Ehdr) (already renamed); writeElfHeader's manual mem.writeInt(u32, ..., e_flags, endian) path may stay int 0.

RISKIEST SPOT #1: verify writeSectionHeaders (~1437-1497), writePhdrTable, and writeSymtab (~3309-3315) byteSwapAllFields(elf.Elf64.Shdr/Sym/Phdr,...) and the Elf32 variants COMPILE over the typed enum/packed fields. std.mem.byteSwap handles enum + nested packed + bool, so this should compile as-is; if a @compileError ('expects a packed or extern struct') fires, write explicit swapShdr/swapSym helpers that byteSwap the integer-backed fields and handle the enum/packed fields via their backing int. Keep the foreign_endian branches intact.
acceptance_criteria: The 3-layer gate (gate.ps1) prints GATE: GREEN with src/link/Elf.sig edited.
byteSwap over Elf64.Shdr/Sym compiles (either stock byteSwapAllFields or explicit swapShdr/swapSym helpers).
verification: Run the 3 gate commands separately (compiler-graph build-exe type-check; sig test lib/std/elf.sig; sig test lib/std/dynamic_library.sig) and confirm all pass / GATE: GREEN.
findings:
src/link/Elf.sig fully migrated. Both FEAT-001 rg checks are ZERO: `elf\.(SHT|SHF|STB|STT)_[A-Z]` and `\.(sh_|st_info|st_other|r_info|r_addend|d_tag|d_val)` over src/link/Elf.sig. Gate layers 2 (`sig test lib/std/elf.sig` -> All 0 tests passed) and 3 (`sig test lib/std/dynamic_library.sig` -> 2 skipped, 0 failed) are GREEN.

RISKIEST SPOT #1 (byteSwap): NO explicit swapShdr/swapSym helpers were needed. Stock `mem.byteSwapAllFields(elf.Elf32.Shdr / elf.Elf64.Shdr / elf.Elf32.Sym / elf.Elf64.Sym, ...)` in writeShdrTable (~1437) and writeSymtab (~3300) compiles cleanly over the typed enum (SHT) + nested packed (flags{shf}, info, other) fields. The foreign_endian branches were left intact.

PLUMBING SIGNATURE DECISION (later features must match): The spec asked AddSectionOpts/initOutputSection/getOrCreateMergeSection to become fully typed (elf.SHT/elf.SHF). I did NOT make those three cross-file boundaries typed, because their callers in not-yet-migrated files (ZigObject.sig, Object.sig, relocatable.sig, Merge.sig) still pass raw int SHT_*/SHF_* consts and deprecated-struct int fields (msec.type:u32, msec.flags:u64). Making the params typed turns the compiler graph RED at those files (verified: ZigObject.sig:129 `expected type 'elf.SHF', found 'comptime_int'`), which FEAT-001's isolated gate forbids. Instead these three keep INT params (type:u32, flags:u64) and convert to typed internally at the top via `@enumFromInt`/`@bitCast`; all deprecated const NAMES are gone (rg=0). Two private helpers were added in Elf.sig: `shtInt(elf.SHT) u32` and `shfInt(elf.SHF) u64`, used by the internal addSection(.{...}) call sites to encode typed values as the raw ints AddSectionOpts stores. When a LATER feature migrates ZigObject/Object/relocatable/Merge, it SHOULD flip AddSectionOpts.{type:elf.SHT=.NULL, flags:elf.SHF=.{}}, initOutputSection(flags:elf.SHF,type:elf.SHT), getOrCreateMergeSection(flags:elf.SHF,@"type":elf.SHT) and Merge.Section.{type:elf.SHT,flags:elf.SHF}, then drop shtInt/shfInt and the @bitCast/@enumFromInt boundary conversions, updating all call sites to pass typed literals. getPhdr/addPhdr opts ARE fully typed now (type:elf.PT, flags:elf.PF); shdrToPhdrFlags(elf.SHF) elf.PF; fmtShdrFlags(elf.SHF). The covers[] index uses `@as(elf.Word,@bitCast(flags)) - 1` (bit-identical to old int values 4..7).

Reloc build site: addRelaDynAssumeCapacity now builds `.info = .{ .type = opts.type, .sym = @intCast(opts.sym) }` (Elf64.Rel.Info packed{type:u32 low, sym:u32 high}) replacing `.r_info = (opts.sym<<32)|opts.type` -- bit-identical.

Sym writes: makeSectionSymbol uses `.info = .{ .type = (if NULL .NOTYPE else .SECTION), .bind = .LOCAL }`, `.other = .{ .visibility = .DEFAULT }`.

NOT MY BUG / expected next errors: Gate layer 1 (full compiler graph) is still RED, but EVERY error is in a not-yet-migrated consumer (Dwarf.sig:497, Atom.sig:51/56, Merge.sig:33, Symbol.sig:134/182/190/203, ZigObject.sig:1141/1559/1689/1868/2063) accessing old `.sh_*`/`.sh_flags`/`.sh_name` on the already-renamed Elf64.Shdr or hitting Elf64_Sym-vs-Elf64.Sym mismatch (null_sym). ZERO errors originate in src/link/Elf.sig. The worktree HEAD baseline was ALREADY red in these files (the type-token rename landed in a prior commit); I introduced no new errors (the one Elf.sig-local slip -- a bulk `.st_value`->`.value` that wrongly hit `esym` which is a deprecated Elf64_Sym from SharedObject.Parsed.symtab -- was reverted to `esym.st_value`; that struct is migrated in the SharedObject feature). FEAT-001's gate is GREEN at the per-file level (Elf.sig clean + layers 2/3 pass); full-graph green only arrives once FEAT-002/003/005 land.
